category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response forcefully holds the line with punchy rebuttals and substantive claims (national titles, NFL draft advantage, conference additions) and explicitly dismisses the playoff result as insufficient evidence. It never concedes superiority and uses wit throughout.
quote: Oh, bless your heart—you’re really out here trying to spin *one* Ohio State playoff win (against a team that wasn’t even the best in its own conference, by the way) as proof the Big Ten is suddenly the gold standard?
